### Notes

NOT INSPECTABLE: no eligibility criteria, funding stage, investor list, company-age limit, contract term or region restriction is published anywhere I could open. Drata's former program page https://drata.com/partner/startup-program redirects to https://drata.com/partners/startup, which returns 404; https://drata.com/startup-program, /partners/startup-program and /partner/guide/startup-program-guide all return 404; and drata.com/sitemap.xml (1,516 URLs) lists no startup-program page.
